headline: Rain spoils the party but the Sox are still cooking
morning_brew: Baseball gods hit the giant red pause button on our win streak last night with that absolute disaster of a rainout. It is a damn shame because the atmosphere at Fenway lately has been electric, and this team was absolutely cooking. We were sitting on fourteen straight wins and I was ready to see if we could keep the train rolling right through Baltimore. Now we have to wait for today's twin bill to see if we can keep this heater alive.

The good news is we get two cracks at them today down at the park. I expect this group to come out with the same focus they have shown all month, because if we learned anything during this run, it is that this squad does not let a little weather rattle their cage. I will be in my seat for both, and if we sweep this doubleheader, my deposit into the Duck Boat fund is going to be significantly higher than I originally planned. I have not seen this much momentum since Uncle Carmine finally put down his newspaper to actually watch the game in 2004.

Elsewhere, training camp is creeping up and it sounds like Harold Landry is dealing with some injury trouble for the Patriots. That is a tough break to hear right before the pads come on, but I am just hoping it is something he can shake off before the season kicks into high gear. We have plenty of football talk coming our way, but for today, all eyes are fixed on Fenway for the doubleheader.

news_digest.headline: Harold Landry headlines Patriots injuries
news_digest.dans_take: Hate to see anyone banged up before camp, let us hope the trainers have him back on the field soon.

news_digest.headline: What should the Red Sox do by the trade deadline? Jeff Passan weighs in
news_digest.dans_take: At this point, if it is not broken, stop trying to fix it and let these guys play.
